name: Cheap Kiosk - Mall Kiosk sells everything for 1 gold
author: Anders
description: The Eldritch Slime shopkeeper in the mall (Core Shop 1, Mall Kiosk) stocks every item, weapon and armor at 1 gold, listed A to Z. Quest/key items and blank placeholder entries are left out. Done in memory only: item prices, other shops and the save file are untouched. Edit the CONFIG block in js/plugins/CheapKiosk.js.
